name: i am feeling things too
source:
This game tells the story of Lydia and Ophelia - two lesbians who experience their first date in person, after they have been talking online for a while. The scene takes place in Ophelia's place, after having had a date on a café in [url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/feeling-things]i am feeling things[/url].

[From [url=https://switch-b.itch.io/feeling-things-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏讲述了莉迪亚（Lydia）和奥菲莉亚（Ophelia）的故事，这两个女同性恋在网上交谈了一段时间后，经历了第一次约会。这一场景发生在奥菲莉亚的住所，在[url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/feeling-things]我正在感受事情[/url]的一家咖啡馆约会后。

[来自[url=https://switch-b.itch.io/feeling-things-2]Itch.io[/url]]
